rationale: One new pluggable game added to an existing 50-game hub with a fixed, proven plugin contract (GamePlugin/GameServices). Net-new surface: pure scoring engine, build-time content generator with a novel fairness gate, free-text answer UI, a 100-bar tension counter, and a practice mode that has no precedent in the repo. No new platform adapters, no backend, no schema migration. Larger than trivial because the panel-scoring model, the beat-par win condition and practice-mode stats isolation are all new semantics, not a reskin of an existing game.

drift_check.note: No .bob/aas.json in repo; relying on bob-sdlc-skills default endpoint resolution. Prior game spec packs in .bob/notes/<slug>/sdlc-plan.md confirm the same path was used previously.
